CustomField.description: Who pays this utility. FSD 5.10.4 gives exactly three values. This is the field the monthly review keys on when deciding whether a rise in charges is a landlord cost or a tenant recharge.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pick Shared when the meter serves more than one party, then record the split on the Meter Allocation related list. If you pick Management, explain why in Reason Management Pays.
CustomField.label: Paid By
